name: dreamtune
description: Model requests, tool APIs, GPU jobs and request traces with a scoped workspace key. Paid operations require workspace credit and the key's permissions.

DREAMTUNE_API_KEY.description: Production workspace API key from the Dreamtune API keys dashboard. Enable only required model, tool or compute permissions.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP. Sends your workspace key in the documented custom header; no browser OAuth.

npm.description: Local stdio adapter. Requires Node.js 22.20 or later; selects the executable explicitly because the package has two binaries.
